annotations.title: Recover a picture after an interruption

description: Read the original saved picture and settlement using the clientRequestId of an earlier picture generation, photo edit, background removal or upscale, after an interruption. Free; it starts no generation. A lost result or unknown charge must be reconciled here, never automatically retried, and a wallet read alone does not recover an image.

clientRequestId.description: Required before generate: one stable UUID per picture purchase. Required before frames; recover and frames_result read the original UUID without a new render. Never retry an unknown outcome automatically or mint a replacement ID to bypass a duplicate refusal.
